text_en: My child, if you accept my words and treasure up my commandments within you,
text_cn: 我儿，你若接受我的话，把我的诫命存在心中，

text_en: making your ear attentive to wisdom and inclining your heart to understanding;
text_cn: 侧耳细听智慧，专心寻求睿智；

text_en: if you indeed cry out for insight, and raise your voice for understanding;
text_cn: 你若呼求明哲，扬声召寻睿智；

text_en: if you seek it like silver, and search for it as for hidden treasures—
text_cn: 你若寻求她如寻求银子，搜索她如搜索宝藏，

text_en: then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find the knowledge of God.
text_cn: 你必能领悟什么是敬畏上主，也能明白什么是认识天主。

text_en: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding;
text_cn: 因为，恩赐智慧的是上主，知识和睿智都出自他的口。

text_en: he stores up sound wisdom for the upright; he is a shield to those who walk blamelessly,
text_cn: 他给正直人保留了救援，又是行止成全者的护盾。

text_en: guarding the paths of justice and preserving the way of his faithful ones.
text_cn: 他护守正直人的行径，他保卫虔诚者的道路；

text_en: Then you will understand righteousness and justice and equity, every good path;
text_cn: 这样，你必能明了仁义和公平，明了正直和一切向善的道路。

text_en: for wisdom will come into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul;
text_cn: 如果智慧进入了你的心，智识成了你的喜乐，

text_en: prudence will watch over you; and understanding will guard you.
text_cn: 慎思就必监护你，睿智也必防守你，

text_en: It will save you from the way of evil, from those who speak perversely,
text_cn: 使你远离邪道，远离言词荒谬的人：

text_en: who forsake the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness,
text_cn: 即那些离弃正道，走上黑暗之途，

text_en: who rejoice in doing evil and delight in the perverseness of evil;
text_cn: 喜爱行恶，在邪恶中喜乐的人。

text_en: those whose paths are crooked, and who are devious in their ways.
text_cn: 他们的道路弯曲不直，他们的行径邪僻不正。

text_en: You will be saved from the loose woman, from the adulteress with her smooth words,
text_cn: 智慧将救你脱离淫妇，脱离甘言蜜语的娼妓。

text_en: who forsakes the partner of her youth and forgets her sacred covenant;
text_cn: 她离弃了少年时的良友，忘记了她的天主的盟约；

text_en: for her way leads down to death, and her paths to the shades;
text_cn: 为此，她的家属趋向死亡， 她的行径通往黄泉；

text_en: those who go to her never come back, nor do they regain the paths of life.
text_cn: 凡行近她的人，没有一个返回，再不会走上生路。

text_en: Therefore walk in the way of the good, and keep to the paths of the just.
text_cn: 为此，你应走善人的道路，持守义人的行径，

text_en: For the upright will abide in the land, and the innocent will remain in it;
text_cn: 因为只有正直的人才能住在地上，只有成全的人方得在那里居留。

text_en: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the treacherous will be rooted out of it.
text_cn: 但是，作恶的人必由地上铲除，违法的人必由其中拔除。
